description: Create an alphabetical index for the AirMax 5000 Service Manual. The document at /home/ga/Documents/hvac_service_manual.docx contains technical descriptions of an HVAC system. You must: (1) Find and mark the following 10 terms as Index Entries throughout the document: 'Compressor', 'Condenser coil', 'Evaporator coil', 'Refrigerant', 'Thermostat', 'Blower motor', 'Expansion valve', 'Economizer', 'Heat exchanger', 'Capacitor'. (2) Move to the end of the document and insert a new page. (3) Add a 'Heading 1' titled 'Index'. (4) Insert an Alphabetical Index below the heading. (5) Save the document as /home/ga/Documents/hvac_manual_indexed.docx.
